text:
Power Stations | Technical Procedure
Introduction
This document lists the equipment 
inspection I1, which must be performed on a weekly bases as indicated by W1 in the 
title block.
The first draft is 
initiated by eng. Sherif Mahrous Omar tested by eng. Nafad Kamel Mahmoud, 
revised by quality engineer Gamal Abd Elwahab, accepted by technical expert eng. 
Hassan Elbehiry and approved by eng. Mohamed Gamal Diab Head sector of El-Kuriemat 
power station.
Safety Precautions
A work permit must be issued and the qualified maintenance 
 staff should carry the suitable ID safety category.
Safety fence with caution marks surrounding the work area is required.
Wear 
 the appropriate safety and healthy equipment as safety 
 helmet, safety shoes, breathing mask, safety glasses,... 
 etc
A work permit must be issued and the qualified maintenance 
 staff should carry the suitable ID safety category.
Safety fence with caution marks surrounding the work area is required.
Tools and Equipment
Safety and healthy equipment
as safety helmet, safety glasses ...etc

Work to be carried out
Check oil level in compressor crank case, but only with the 
compressor at rest, the oil level should never fall below the sight-glass
Check for any unusual noises or vibrations
Check for air leaks in piping and pipe connections
Read and record gauge pressures and compressor running time 
indicator
Clean compressor room floor
Check oil level in compressor crank case, but only with the 
compressor at rest, the oil level should never fall below the sight-glass
Check for any unusual noises or vibrations
Check for air leaks in piping and pipe connections

indicator

sections_ar.text: يسرد هذا المستند فحص المعدات I1، الذي يجب إجراؤه أسبوعيًا كما هو موضح بالرمز W1 في خانة العنوان.

أُعدت المسودة الأولى بواسطة م. شريف محروس عمر، واختبرها م. نافذ كامل محمود، وراجعها مهندس الجودة جمال عبد الوهاب، وقبلها الخبير الفني م. حسن البحيري، واعتمدها م. محمد جمال دياب رئيس قطاع محطة كهرباء الكريمات.
يجب إصدار تصريح عمل، وأن يحمل فريق الصيانة المؤهل فئة السلامة المناسبة.
يلزم وجود سياج سلامة به علامات تحذير يحيط بمنطقة العمل.
ارتدِ مهمات السلامة والوقاية المناسبة مثل خوذة السلامة وحذاء السلامة وقناع التنفس ونظارة السلامة ... إلخ.

افحص وجود أي أصوات أو اهتزازات غير عادية.

اقرأ وسجّل ضغوط العدادات ومبين زمن تشغيل الضاغط.
